actions.value:
. /home/probe/session-env
date -u +%FT%T.%N
cp /home/probe/evidence/localsend.log /home/probe/evidence/localsend-before-A.log
ln -sf /home/probe/evidence/localsend-A.log /home/probe/evidence/localsend.log
nohup flatpak run --filesystem=/home/probe/evidence:ro --env=G_MESSAGES_DEBUG=all --env=LD_PRELOAD=/home/probe/evidence/atspi254/A-stage/usr/local/lib64/libatk-bridge-2.0.so.0.0.0 org.localsend.localsend_app > /home/probe/evidence/localsend-A.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &

. /home/probe/session-env
date -u +%FT%T.%N
pid=$(pgrep -n -x localsend_app || pgrep -n -x localsend)
echo PID=$pid
cat /proc/$pid/stat
flatpak info org.localsend.localsend_app
gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications screen-magnifier-enabled
gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface toolkit-accessibility
cat /proc/$pid/maps | grep -E 'atk|atspi|flutter|glib|gobject'
sha256sum /proc/$pid/root/home/probe/evidence/atspi254/A-stage/usr/local/lib64/libatk-bridge-2.0.so.0.0.0 /proc/$pid/root/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libatk-1.0.so.0 /proc/$pid/root/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libatspi.so.0 /proc/$pid/root/app/lib/libflutter_linux_gtk.so
cat /home/probe/evidence/localsend-A.log
